rule: Internal ranking engine, src/lib/rank with config/ranking.json. Hand table for c02 c03 c06 c13 c15 c18 (HAND_SET), pinned and resorted so p1 obeys the rule; pinned new-user picks for c20 (NEW_USER_PRIOR).
